name: abap2ui5-ai-demokit
description: Generated abap2UI5 ports of the official UI5 demo kit samples.

scripts.gates: node scripts/pattern-lint.mjs && node scripts/validate-meta.mjs && node scripts/structural-diff.mjs --strict && node scripts/data-fidelity.mjs && node scripts/check-mcp-contract.mjs && node scripts/generate-overview.mjs && node scripts/generate-coverage.mjs && node scripts/generate-status.mjs && git diff --exit-code -- src README.md api.md STATUS.md
scripts.gates:full: npm run gates && npx abaplint ./abaplint.jsonc && node scripts/view-gates.mjs --strict
scripts.syfixes: find src -type f -name '*.abap' -exec sed -i -e 's/ RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found/ ASSERT 1 = 0/g' {} +
scripts.downport: abaplint --fix .github/abaplint/abap_702.jsonc && npm run syfixes && cp -f .github/abaplint/abap_702.jsonc abaplint.jsonc && npm run abaplintpathfix
